# vs-4-batch-summary

## Description

The batch summary response gains new fields for per-entity progress
tracking, exposed once the upload worker finishes each entity in the batch.

## Labels

type:backend

## Signals

```json
{
  "services_identified": 1,
  "symbols_resolved": 0,
  "prior_art_found": false,
  "complexity": "moderate",
  "exploration_depth": "standard",
  "TargetSymbols": ""
}
```
